data.raw_text: LOOK: Youth and artists groups, including student council delegates of #GASC60, perform a chalk art protest in front of Vinzons Hall, UP Diliman, coinciding with the National Day of Action Against Media Attacks and sixth year of Frenchie Mae Cumpio’s unlawful arrest today, Feb. 7.
